contact.name: Alvin Smith
contact.evidence_quote: At the age of 12, Alvin Smith began sweeping and sorting bottles at the Seven-Up plant in Jennings, Louisiana. In 1950, he moved his young family to Lafayette where he became an equity partner in a joint venture with Seven-Up Bottling Company of Jennings, and manager of the Lafayette facility, which was running only two routes at the time.
